#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
合伙人风险预警体系 V1.0
早期信号识别 + 分级预警 + 干预建议
"""

import json
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

class AlertLevel(Enum):
    GREEN = "green"       # 正常
    YELLOW = "yellow"     # 关注
    ORANGE = "orange"     # 警告
    RED = "red"           # 危险
    BLACK = "black"       # 危机

@dataclass
class RiskSignal:
    """风险信号"""
    signal_type: str
    description: str
    severity: AlertLevel
